## Futures

S&P 500 futures were down 1.14% and Nasdaq 100 futures fell 2.68%, the sharpest drop among the major contracts. Dow futures slipped 0.14% and Russell 2000 futures lost 0.61%.

## Biggest premarket movers

Intel (INTC) plunged 26.0% after issuing a weak fourth-quarter forecast, citing continued softness in the global PC market, and reporting lower third-quarter profit. HP Inc. (HPQ) fell 13.3% and Dell (DELL) dropped 11.9%; no reasons were provided for either. Stryker (SYK) slid 10.4% after third-quarter results missed expectations. Arm (ARM) lost 10.1%; coverage noted sharp declines over the past week and month and a 94x forward multiple.

On the upside, Mondelez (MDLZ) rose 7.1% after adjusted earnings per share of $0.78 came in ahead of the roughly $0.73 consensus. Regeneron (REGN) gained 7.1% as third-quarter revenue surged 36% to $5.12 billion, above estimates of $4.56 billion. Colgate-Palmolive (CL) added 5.5% amid noted momentum ahead of results. AstraZeneca (AZN) climbed 5.3% on stronger-than-expected third-quarter earnings, with oncology driving growth. Equifax (EFX) rose 4.4%; no reasons were provided.

## Macro & overnight

US stock futures fell for a second day after another round of disappointing tech earnings accelerated a rotation out of the sector. Nasdaq 100 futures sank more than 2% after earnings from Amazon and Intel raised fresh concerns about capital expenditure. Bitcoin fell 1.2% after Binance, the world's largest crypto exchange, suspended all deposits and withdrawals as it investigated a suspected hack.
